acceptanceCriteria: The behaviour requested in beamfall/corvint#773 is delivered spec-first: numbered requirements (owner-accepted) in the owning spec, with focused tests or measured evidence tracing each one.
Missing evidence yields an explicit unknown or abstention, never invented certainty; read commands stay read-only.
The GitHub issue #773 is closed only after native completion, with a link to the landing PR.
body:
GitHub beamfall/corvint#773, filed by the owner 2026-10-11. Related: V1-0968, V1-1077 (appmap).

## Problem
`flows appmap build` accepts exactly one router dialect (`ui-router-states/0`). Applications that mix an AngularJS shell with server-rendered pages (Rails-style `routes.rb`) and component-router islands (React Router `createBrowserRouter`/`<Route>` trees) get no screens for those surfaces, so the screen graph, test join, scenario planner and consolidation planner all read those screens as missing (not UNKNOWN), which is not fail-closed for the whole application.

## Proposal
Add two dialects with the same literal-only, fail-closed rules as AMAP-V0-002:
- `rails-routes/0`: `get/post/resources/resource/namespace/scope/member/collection/root/mount` with literal arguments; named route helpers become state names; `constraints`, `defaults` and lambdas read UNKNOWN; `draw` partial files followed one level.
- `react-router/0`: object-form route arrays and JSX `<Route path element>` trees with literal `path`, nested via `children`/JSX nesting; `lazy`, computed paths and spreads read UNKNOWN.
Also a manifest-level "app coverage" summary: router files matched by a declared glob but not listed in `routers` (today a manifest silently caps at 64 routers).

## Acceptance criteria
- Fixtures per dialect: nested resources, namespace + scope, shallow routes, JSX and object routers, index routes, splats.
- Every non-literal construct produces a named UNKNOWN reason; no screen is guessed.
- A route file present under a declared glob but absent from `routers` is reported as `router-not-declared`.
- Template collision keys are shared across dialects so URL lookup works on mixed apps.

Doc gates, repin check, independent review and dogfood bind/check/seal reported PASS in the PR. make gate NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference); native claim unavailable (COVERAGE_UNKNOWN/RESOURCE_COLLISION).
